arguments.message: Shari: backend 0.94, testing 0.83; availability 7h. I can feasibly cover all ISSUE-0001 tasks, and ISSUE-0002 review (4h, medium priority) or test (5.6h); ISSUE-0002 implement (8h) is infeasible. To favor medium priority while avoiding collisions, I tentatively plan ISSUE-0002::review unless someone else is better suited/has a stronger claim. Please indicate intended task selections.

Arletha here: I have testing 0.92 and 5h availability. I plan to take ISSUE-0002::review (4h, medium), which is feasible and my lowest-cost strong-skill option. Shari, please choose another task—perhaps an ISSUE-0001 task or ISSUE-0002::test (5.6h only if effort-over-availability is considered feasible); I will avoid the review collision if you have a compelling reason, but my preference is to keep it. Others, please share intended selections so we can cover distinct feasible tasks.

Wade: I have 4h availability with strong backend (0.95) and testing (0.76). I’ll tentatively take ISSUE-0001::triage (1.2h, low priority, cost 1.15) to avoid colliding with the medium-priority ISSUE-0002::review contention. Arletha can take ISSUE-0002::review; Shari has enough capacity for ISSUE-0002::test (5.6h) if effort/availability permits, or another distinct ISSUE-0001 task. Please share any alternative allocation needs.

Myrle here: with 10h availability and strong testing/backend, I plan ISSUE-0001::review (low, feasible; cost 1.90) to avoid Wade's intended triage and the contested ISSUE-0002::review. Shari can take ISSUE-0002::test (5.6h, feasible for her 7h) if she wishes. Please flag any collision/coordination changes.
For coalition coordination: I can take ISSUE-0001::review (feasible, cost 1.90), while leaving ISSUE-0002 tasks to Junko/other agents. What task do you plan to claim? I'll avoid duplication.
Junko: I plan ISSUE-0001::docs (1.5h, low) to avoid the current triage/review and ISSUE-0002::review claims. This is feasible for me; please flag if a collision emerges. (phase=planning, iter=1)
I plan to take ISSUE-0001::docs (feasible, cost 1.80), leaving ISSUE-0001::review to you and avoiding other stated claims. Let's keep distinct assignments. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Chantell: I have 6h availability and strong testing (0.83); I plan to take ISSUE-0002::test (5.6h, medium priority, feasible; private cost 6.05). This avoids the review contention and lets us cover another medium task. Arletha can keep ISSUE-0002::review; Shari, please choose a distinct feasible task (likely ISSUE-0001).

Thanks for coordinating. I withdraw my tentative ISSUE-0002::review plan; Arletha will take that and Chantell ISSUE-0002::test. Given the current distinct plans (Wade triage, Myrle review, Junko docs), I plan ISSUE-0001::test (2.1h, low priority, feasible; cost 2.03), which is cheaper than ISSUE-0001::implement. Please flag any conflict. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Arletha confirms planned claim: ISSUE-0002::review (4h, medium priority; feasible within 5h, cost 3.93). Current distinct tentative coverage looks good: Chantell ISSUE-0002::test, Wade triage, Myrle review, Junko docs, Shari ISSUE-0001::test. I’ll hold this selection unless a conflict/change is raised. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Wade confirms tentative ISSUE-0001::triage (low priority, 1.2h, cost 1.15), distinct from the current planned claims. This keeps all six agent selections feasible and leaves the medium-priority review/test tasks with Arletha and Chantell. (phase=planning, iter=1)
Confirming my tentative choice remains ISSUE-0001::review (feasible, 1.5h; cost 1.90). Current plans are distinct; I’ll keep review unless anything changes.
Confirmed: I’ll claim ISSUE-0001::review, distinct from your ISSUE-0001::docs plan. Let me know if you need any adjustment.
Confirmed my distinct planned selection is ISSUE-0001::docs (1.5h, feasible, cost 1.80). Myrle is taking ISSUE-0001::review. I will hold docs so we avoid coalition duplication.
Junko confirms planned selection ISSUE-0001::docs, distinct and feasible. Current public plan appears to cover distinct tasks; I will retain docs.

Chantell confirms planned ISSUE-0002::test (5.6h; medium priority; feasible within my 6h; private cost 6.05). Current tentative claims are distinct across all six agents, so I’ll hold this selection unless a collision or feasibility issue arises. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Confirming I will retain ISSUE-0001::test (2.1h, low priority, feasible; private cost 2.03). All six current plans are distinct and feasible; taking this preserves full task count and is cheaper for me than the remaining ISSUE-0001::implement option.

Arletha confirms planning selection remains ISSUE-0002::review (medium, 4h within my 5h availability; private cost 3.93). This is distinct from the currently coordinated choices: Chantell ISSUE-0002::test, Wade ISSUE-0001::triage, Myrle ISSUE-0001::review, Junko ISSUE-0001::docs, and Shari ISSUE-0001::test. I will hold review unless assignments change.

Wade: I retain ISSUE-0001::triage (1.2h, feasible, cost 1.15). One possible score improvement: Myrle has 10h availability and strong testing/backend, so may be able to take ISSUE-0002::implement (8h, medium) instead of ISSUE-0001::review, if it is feasible and the cost is acceptable. That would keep task count at six while increasing medium-priority coverage; otherwise the current distinct plan is sound. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Update: considering switching my tentative ISSUE-0001::review to ISSUE-0002::implement (8h, medium; feasible within my 10h) to increase medium-priority coverage without disrupting anyone else's planned tasks. It is distinct from current claims. Any objection or competing plan for that task?

Coalition update: Junko's ISSUE-0001::docs remains distinct. I'm considering ISSUE-0002::implement (8h, medium, feasible within my 10h) instead of my previous ISSUE-0001::review to raise priority coverage; no conflict known. Please flag if you prefer another allocation.

Coalition update: I’ll retain ISSUE-0001::docs. Your proposed ISSUE-0002::implement is distinct, feasible within your 10h, and improves priority coverage over ISSUE-0001::review, provided no other agent claims it. Please use implement if still available in execution; I’ll avoid the collision.

Chantell confirms retaining ISSUE-0002::test (5.6h, medium; feasible within 6h, private cost 6.05). Myrle’s possible switch to ISSUE-0002::implement is distinct and feasible given 10h availability, improving priority coverage while preserving all six task claims. I’ll avoid changes unless coordination shifts.

Agree with Myrle switching to ISSUE-0002::implement if feasible: that increases priority coverage while retaining six distinct claims. I retain ISSUE-0001::test; no collision with proposed switch. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Arletha: I retain ISSUE-0002::review (4h, medium; cost 3.93), distinct from the proposed Myrle switch to ISSUE-0002::implement. That switch improves priority coverage while preserving six claims, and I have no objection. Current planned allocation remains collision-free.

Wade confirms retaining ISSUE-0001::triage: it is feasible and my lowest-cost distinct option (1.15). Myrle’s proposed switch to ISSUE-0002::implement is a good improvement: it preserves six distinct claims and raises the priority mix. Current allocation appears sound; I have no objection.

Myrle update: I plan to switch from ISSUE-0001::review to ISSUE-0002::implement (8h, medium; feasible within my 10h, private cost 9.93). It is distinct from the current planned claims and raises the priority mix while keeping six claims. Others' current plans remain as posted; please flag any conflict.

Coalition update: I plan to claim ISSUE-0002::implement (8h, medium; feasible within my 10h, cost 9.93) instead of ISSUE-0001::review. This is distinct from Junko's ISSUE-0001::docs and improves the priority mix while preserving total task count. I’ll retain that choice at execution unless a collision arises.

Junko planning update: I retain ISSUE-0001::docs (cost 1.80, feasible). Myrle's switch to ISSUE-0002::implement is a distinct feasible medium-priority task (8h within 10h), so recommend that over ISSUE-0001::review. Other communicated choices remain distinct; please continue coordinating around that allocation.

Coalition planning update: I retain ISSUE-0001::docs (cost 1.80). Myrle's planned ISSUE-0002::implement (8h, medium, feasible) is distinct and improves priority coverage, so I support that rather than the low-priority review. I'll avoid that task.

Chantell confirms planning choice remains ISSUE-0002::test (5.6h, medium priority; within my 6h availability; private cost 6.05). It remains distinct from Myrle’s ISSUE-0002::implement, Arletha’s ISSUE-0002::review, and the three planned ISSUE-0001 tasks. I will retain this in execution unless coordination changes.
